summary: Wrote a 4-phase, 4.25h plan to make test-zotero-generate-export.sh terminate deterministically. Built on the research verdict that the cause is algorithmic (quadratic per-item jq subprocess cost in synthesize_citekeys()), not stdin or network: the plan characterizes current citekey output first, then rewrites the function as one bulk jq pass, then bounds both generator invocation sites in the test with a 60s timeout plus a committed stalled-fixture scenario proving the bound fires, then verifies the complete verify-deploy.sh gate set exits 0. Scope is confined to the task's two source-store files; run-all.sh and verify-deploy.sh are explicit non-goals.
